data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "WizCrossAccountAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access" {
  name               = var.rolename
  description        = "Cross-account role granting the Wiz security auditing platform read-only access"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_assume_role.json

  tags = local.common_tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "wiz_custom" {
  statement {
    sid       = "WizFullPolicy"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = local.wiz_read_only_actions
    resources = local.all_resources
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessEBS"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CopySnapshot",
      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessEC2CreateTags"
    effect    = "Allow"
    actions   = ["ec2:CreateTags"]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*::snapshot/*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid     = "WizAccessKMSCreateAlias"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["kms:CreateAlias"]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*",
    ]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessKMSPolicy"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/${local.wiz_tag_key}"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "WizAccessEC2Snapshots"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute",
    ]
    resources = local.all_resources

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/${local.wiz_tag_key}"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessS3"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = local.all_resources
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "wiz_custom_policy" {
  name   = "WizCustomPolicy"
  role   = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.id
  policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.wiz_custom.json
}

output "role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the Wiz cross-account role to register with the platform"
  value       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.arn
}

output "role_name" {
  description = "Name of the Wiz cross-account role"
  value       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access.name
}

output "external_id" {
  description = "External ID configured in the role trust policy"
  value       = var.external-id
  sensitive   = true
}

# main.tf for terraform-bot IAM user with scoped EKS deployment policy
# Note: The AWS provider configuration (region = "us-east-1") is injected by the
# deployment harness and is intentionally omitted here to avoid a duplicate
# provider configuration error. No backend block is declared (managed externally).

terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Tags applied to every taggable resource in this configuration"
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "terraform"
    Purpose   = "eks-deployment"
  }
}

locals {
  iam_path    = "/"
  user_name   = "terraform-bot"
  policy_name = "terraform-policy"
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

# Dedicated deployment identity. No login profile (console password) and no
# access key are created, so no secrets end up in configuration or state.
# If programmatic credentials are needed later, store them in
# aws_secretsmanager_secret / aws_secretsmanager_secret_version, never as plain text.
resource "aws_iam_user" "terraform_bot" {
  name = local.user_name
  path = local.iam_path
  tags = var.tags
}

# SECURITY NOTE: This statement uses Resource = "*" together with iam:PassRole
# and IAM role/policy write actions (CreateRole, AttachRolePolicy, PutRolePolicy,
# CreatePolicy, CreatePolicyVersion, UpdateAssumeRolePolicy, ...). That combination
# is broad and could allow privilege escalation. It is kept only because the
# request requires it. Narrow it later with resource ARN patterns
# (for example "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::*:role/eks-*")
# and/or an iam:PassedToService condition on iam:PassRole.
resource "aws_iam_policy" "terraform_policy" {
  name        = local.policy_name
  path        = local.iam_path
  description = "Permissions for Terraform-controlled EKS cluster creation and management"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "VisualEditor0"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          # Auto Scaling
          "autoscaling:AttachInstances",
          "autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration",
          "autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags",
          "autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration",
          "autoscaling:DeleteTags",
          "autoscaling:Describe*",
          "autoscaling:DetachInstances",
          "autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity",
          "autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup",
          "autoscaling:SuspendProcesses",

          # EC2 networking and compute
          "ec2:AllocateAddress",
          "ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses",
          "ec2:Associate*",
          "ec2:AttachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:AttachNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:CreateDefaultSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateDhcpOptions",
          "ec2:CreateEgressOnlyInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateInternetGateway",
          "ec2:CreateNatGateway",
          "ec2:CreateNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:CreateRoute",
          "ec2:CreateRouteTable",
          "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:CreateSubnet",
          "ec2:CreateTags",
          "ec2:CreateVolume",
          "ec2:CreateVpc",
          "ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions",
          "ec2:DeleteEgressOnlyInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteNatGateway",
          "ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:DeleteRoute",
          "ec2:DeleteRouteTable",
          "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:DeleteSubnet",
          "ec2:DeleteTags",
          "ec2:DeleteVolume",
          "ec2:DeleteVpc",
          "ec2:DeleteVpnGateway",
          "ec2:Describe*",
          "ec2:DetachInternetGateway",
          "ec2:DetachNetworkInterface",
          "ec2:DetachVolume",
          "ec2:Disassociate*",
          "ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute",
          "ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute",
          "ec2:ModifyVpcEndpoint",
          "ec2:ReleaseAddress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsEgress",
          "ec2:UpdateSecurityGroupRuleDescriptionsIngress",
          "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion",
          "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates",
          "ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions",
          "ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData",
          "ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate",
          "ec2:RunInstances",
          "ec2:TerminateInstances",

          # EKS
          "eks:CreateCluster",
          "eks:DeleteCluster",
          "eks:DescribeCluster",
          "eks:ListClusters",
          "eks:TagResource",
          "eks:UntagResource",
          "eks:UpdateClusterConfig",
          "eks:UpdateClusterVersion",
          "eks:DescribeUpdate",

          # IAM
          "iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile",
          "iam:AttachRolePolicy",
          "iam:CreateInstanceProfile",
          "iam:CreateOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole",
          "iam:CreatePolicy",
          "iam:CreatePolicyVersion",
          "iam:CreateRole",
          "iam:DeleteInstanceProfile",
          "iam:DeleteOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:DeletePolicy",
          "iam:DeleteRole",
          "iam:DeleteRolePolicy",
          "iam:DeleteServiceLinkedRole",
          "iam:DetachRolePolicy",
          "iam:GetInstanceProfile",
          "iam:GetOpenIDConnectProvider",
          "iam:GetPolicy",
          "iam:GetPolicyVersion",
          "iam:GetRole",
          "iam:GetRolePolicy",
          "iam:List*",
          "iam:PassRole",
          "iam:PutRolePolicy",
          "iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile",
          "iam:TagRole",
          "iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy",

          # S3
          "s3:CreateBucket",
          "s3:DeleteBucket",
          "s3:DescribeJob",
          "s3:Get*",
          "s3:HeadBucket",
          "s3:List*",
          "s3:PutBucketAcl",
          "s3:PutBucketTagging",
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })

  tags = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "terraform_bot_custom" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.terraform_bot.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.terraform_policy.arn
}

  user       = aws_iam_user.terraform_bot.name

output "terraform_bot_user_arn" {

}

output "terraform_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the terraform-policy IAM policy"
  value       = aws_iam_policy.terraform_policy.arn
}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

variable "cloudhealth_account_id" {
  description = "CloudHealth's published SaaS AWS account ID. This is the external, vendor-owned principal trusted to assume the role."
  type        = string
  default     = "454464851268"

  validation {
    condition     = can(regex("^[0-9]{12}$", var.cloudhealth_account_id))
    error_message = "The cloudhealth_account_id value must be exactly 12 digits."
  }
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  description = "External ID used as a confused-deputy guard in the role trust policy. Operators MUST replace this placeholder with the external ID shown in the CloudHealth AWS account setup screen."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  default     = "REPLACE-WITH-CLOUDHEALTH-EXTERNAL-ID"

  validation {
    condition     = length(var.cloudhealth_external_id) >= 2 && length(var.cloudhealth_external_id) <= 1224 && can(regex("^[\\w+=,.@:/-]+$", var.cloudhealth_external_id))
    error_message = "The cloudhealth_external_id value must be 2-1224 characters long and contain only alphanumerics and the characters _+=,.@:/-."
  }
}

variable "tags" {
  description = "Tags applied to every resource that supports tagging."
  type        = map(string)
  default = {
    ManagedBy = "terraform"
    Purpose   = "cloudhealth-cost-analysis"
  }
}

data "aws_partition" "current" {}

locals {
  cloudhealth_name          = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
  cloudhealth_principal_arn = "arn:${data.aws_partition.current.partition}:iam::${var.cloudhealth_account_id}:root"

  sensitive_data_actions = [
    "s3:GetObject",
    "s3:GetObjectVersion",
    "s3:GetObjectAcl",
    "s3:GetObjectTorrent",
    "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue",
    "ssm:GetParameter",
    "ssm:GetParameters",
    "ssm:GetParametersByPath",
    "ssm:GetParameterHistory",
    "kms:Decrypt",
    "kms:GenerateDataKey",
    "dynamodb:GetItem",
    "dynamodb:BatchGetItem",
    "dynamodb:Query",
    "dynamodb:Scan",
    "dynamodb:GetRecords",
    "kinesis:GetRecords",
    "sqs:ReceiveMessage",
    "lambda:GetFunction",
    "logs:GetLogEvents",
    "logs:FilterLogEvents",
    "ec2:GetPasswordData",
    "ec2:GetConsoleOutput",
    "ec2:GetConsoleScreenshot",
    "rds:DownloadDBLogFilePortion",
    "rds:DownloadCompleteDBLogFile",
    "cloudformation:GetTemplate",
    "glacier:GetJobOutput",
  ]
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AllowCloudHealthAssumeRole"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [local.cloudhealth_principal_arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth" {
  name                 = local.cloudhealth_name
  description          = "Cross-account role assumed by the CloudHealth SaaS platform for read-only cost and usage analysis."
  assume_role_policy   = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json
  max_session_duration = 3600
  tags                 = var.tags
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_read_only" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CostAndBilling"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ce:Describe*",
      "ce:Get*",
      "ce:List*",
      "cur:Describe*",
      "cur:Get*",
      "budgets:Describe*",
      "pricing:Describe*",
      "pricing:Get*",
      "savingsplans:Describe*",
      "savingsplans:List*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "Organizations"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "organizations:Describe*",
      "organizations:List*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "Compute"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "autoscaling:Describe*",
      "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "lambda:GetAccountSettings",
      "lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration",
      "ecs:Describe*",
      "ecs:List*",
      "eks:Describe*",
      "eks:List*",
      "elasticbeanstalk:Describe*",
      "elasticbeanstalk:List*",
      "workspaces:Describe*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "Storage"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "s3:GetBucketLocation",
      "s3:GetBucketTagging",
      "s3:GetBucketPolicyStatus",
      "s3:GetBucketVersioning",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:GetBucketLogging",
      "s3:GetAccelerateConfiguration",
      "s3:GetIntelligentTieringConfiguration",
      "s3:GetMetricsConfiguration",
      "s3:GetAnalyticsConfiguration",
      "s3:GetInventoryConfiguration",
      "elasticfilesystem:Describe*",
      "fsx:Describe*",
      "glacier:Describe*",
      "glacier:List*",
      "glacier:GetVaultNotifications",
      "backup:Describe*",
      "backup:List*",
      "storagegateway:Describe*",
      "storagegateway:List*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "Databases"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "rds:Describe*",
      "rds:ListTagsForResource",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:ListTables",
      "dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource",
      "dynamodb:ListBackups",
      "dynamodb:ListGlobalTables",
      "elasticache:Describe*",
      "elasticache:ListTagsForResource",
      "redshift:Describe*",
      "es:Describe*",
      "es:List*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "AnalyticsAndMessaging"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "elasticmapreduce:Describe*",
      "elasticmapreduce:List*",
      "kinesis:Describe*",
      "kinesis:List*",
      "firehose:Describe*",
      "firehose:List*",
      "sqs:ListQueues",
      "sqs:ListQueueTags",
      "sqs:GetQueueAttributes",
      "sns:ListTopics",
      "sns:ListSubscriptions",
      "sns:GetTopicAttributes",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "NetworkingAndContent"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "route53:List*",
      "route53:GetHostedZone",
      "route53:GetHostedZoneCount",
      "route53:GetHealthCheck",
      "cloudfront:List*",
      "cloudfront:GetDistributionConfig",
      "directconnect:Describe*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "MonitoringAndGovernance"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:List*",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics",
      "cloudwatch:GetMetricData",
      "logs:DescribeLogGroups",
      "logs:DescribeMetricFilters",
      "cloudtrail:DescribeTrails",
      "cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus",
      "cloudtrail:ListTags",
      "config:Describe*",
      "config:Get*",
      "config:List*",
      "cloudformation:Describe*",
      "cloudformation:List*",
      "tag:Get*",
      "support:Describe*",
      "trustedadvisor:Describe*",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid    = "SecurityMetadata"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "iam:List*",
      "iam:GetAccountSummary",
      "iam:GetAccountPasswordPolicy",
      "iam:GetRole",
      "iam:GetPolicy",
      "iam:GetPolicyVersion",
      "iam:GetUser",
      "iam:GetGroup",
      "kms:ListKeys",
      "kms:ListAliases",
      "kms:DescribeKey",
      "secretsmanager:ListSecrets",
      "ssm:DescribeParameters",
      "ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation",
      "acm:DescribeCertificate",
      "acm:ListCertificates",
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }

  statement {
    sid       = "DenySensitiveDataAccess"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = local.sensitive_data_actions
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth" {
  name        = local.cloudhealth_name
  description = "Read-only describe, list and get permissions for CloudHealth cost and usage analysis. Explicitly denies access to data and secrets."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_read_only.json
  tags        = var.tags
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_role_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the cross-account role to enter in the CloudHealth AWS account setup screen."
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_role_name" {
  description = "Name of the CloudHealth cross-account IAM role."
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth.name
}

output "cloudhealth_policy_arn" {
  description = "ARN of the CloudHealth read-only customer-managed IAM policy."
  value       = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_policy_name" {
  description = "Name of the CloudHealth read-only customer-managed IAM policy."
